summary: Reported error 0x8007007e is HRESULT_FROM_WIN32(ERROR_MOD_NOT_FOUND); the only call in dxbc2dxil.cpp that can produce it is GetDxcCreateInstance's LoadLibraryExW(L'dxilconv.dll', ..., LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_APPLICATION_DIR), which runs before the DXBC is ever passed to converter->Convert(). Confirmed both by HRESULT arithmetic and a standalone out-of-tree Win32 harness reproducing the exact code. The attached DXBC is well-formed (correct fourcc and TotalSize), so the content is likely not the cause. dxbc2dxil declares no CMake dependency on dxilconv (only on the statically-linked DxbcConverter), so a selective build/copy of dxbc2dxil.exe without its sibling dxilconv.dll would reproduce this exactly, consistent with the reporter's own uncertainty about what their build included. Cannot execute dxbc2dxil/dxilconv end-to-end in this environment (HLSL_BUILD_DXILCONV=OFF here, no rebuilds permitted, and no cataloged release ships these binaries), so whether DxbcConverter itself would convert this DXBC correctly once the module loads is unmeasured.
